sources.title: MUWU/MAGIC-RN50-experts · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MAGIC: author-trained RN50 experts Eight RN50 experts fine-tuned by the MAGIC authors for SUN397, Cars, RESISC45, EuroSAT, SVHN, GTSRB, MNIST and DTD. These are our experimental checkpoints, rather than third-party fine-tuned experts. All experts share the same pretrained OpenAI CLIP RN50 initialization. The upstream backbone is from OpenAI CLIP; MAGIC code is at lyymuwu/MAGIC.
